map.输入化学式自动解析元素并计算分子量，支持括号与嵌套，内置全部 118 种元素原子: Parse a chemical formula including brackets and nesting, and compute its molar mass using the atomic weights of all 118 elements.
map.元素符号首字母大写，如: Element symbols start with a capital letter (e.g. H, O, Fe).
map.数字表示该元素（或括号组）的原子个数，省略时默认为 1: Numbers denote the atom count of an element (or bracket group); omitted defaults to 1
map.原子量采用 IUPAC 标准原子量，部分人造元素取最稳定同位素质量数: Atomic weights use IUPAC standard; for some synthetic elements the most stable isotope mass number is used
map.结果保留两位小数，仅作化学计算参考: Results keep two decimals, for chemical calculation reference only
map.本工具纯前端运行，无需联网: This tool runs purely in the browser, no internet needed
map.配制溶液前由浓度、体积与摩尔质量计算所需质量。: Before preparing a solution, compute the needed mass from concentration, volume and molar mass.
map.各原子相对原子质量×下标求和。: Sum each element's relative atomic weight × subscript.
map.要算。如 CuSO₄·5H₂O 需把 5 个结晶水计入摩尔质量。: Yes. e.g. CuSO₄·5H₂O must include the 5 crystal-water molecules in molar mass.
map.输入化学式（如 H2O、C6H12O6、Fe2(SO4)3）自动解析元素组成并计: Enter a chemical formula (e.g. H2O, C6H12O6, Fe2(SO4)3) to auto-parse the composition and compute molar mass, supporting bracket nesting and hydrate notation, with all 118 elements' standard atomic weights and an element breakdown.
